title: Global Sea Surface Currents and Temperature
description: Ocean surface currents swirl around the globe, coloured by sea surface temperature from the ECCO2 ocean model (MIT/JPL) on a 0 to 32 °C colour bar, March 2007 to February 2008. The flute melody is the global average sea surface temperature, frame by frame: it moves over about 0.9 °C. Six soft pads underneath are the six latitude bands. A hydrophone recording of the Pacific swells with how much the currents move, and the model-written strings and bass follow the flute without changing it.

legend.meaning: Global mean sea surface temperature. Higher pitch means warmer. The two-octave range covers 18.9 to 19.8 °C, so small changes are easy to hear.

Average temperature of six latitude bands, 30 degrees each, from 90° North to 90° South. Pitch spans the full colour bar, 0 to 32 °C, so warm tropical bands are high and cold polar bands are low. Each band also sits in its own register, shifted by up to 6 semitones: northern bands a little higher, southern a little lower.
MBARI Pacific hydrophone and surf recordings; louder and denser when the currents in the movie move more (frame-to-frame activity), brighter when the ocean is warmer.
Press A to swap the lead for the same temperatures played in random order. It sounds like a tune but no longer follows the ocean.
written by the Anticipatory Music Transformer around the data melody; it never changes a data note and carries no data
section changes found in the video frames (DINOv2 novelty); cues only, no data

fidelity.method: note-level register-bounded pyin on the final rendered audio

data_source: ECCO2 ocean model (MIT/JPL), as rendered in NASA SVS visualization 3912. Values were recovered from the movie by inverting its 0 to 32 °C colour bar; 57% of pixels matched the colour bar (land, labels and gaps between flow lines are skipped). The absolute level is uncertain by about 1 to 2 °C because the flow lines are drawn dimmed; the changes through the year are reliable.

band_pitch_map.note: Each band uses this map shifted by its sweep pitch_offset (jukebox.score.mapping.band_voices).

summary: Ocean temperature, frame by frame, over a Pacific hydrophone; model-written strings and bass. Geophony.
